Line.DefaultText: He says he's a trader from a town far to the west. He crosses through the forest every year during spring and autumn.
Line.Text: 他说自己是来自一个遥远西部小镇的商人，每年春秋之时都会经过这片森林。

Line.en: He says he's a trader from a town far to the west. He crosses through the forest every year during spring and autumn.
Line.ja: 彼は西の遠い町から来た商人だと言っている。春と秋に毎年森を通過する。

Line.DefaultText:
He's interested in leather, pelts and fairyweed.
Usually brings rye, vegetables, salt and some meat.
Line.Text: 他对皮革、毛皮和仙灵草感兴趣。\n通常会带来黑麦、蔬菜、盐和一些肉。
Line.zh: 他对皮革、毛皮和仙灵草感兴趣。\n通常会带来黑麦、蔬菜、盐和一些肉。
Line.en: He's interested in leather, pelts and fairyweed.\nUsually brings rye, vegetables, salt and some meat.
Line.ja: 彼は革、毛皮、妖精草に興味がある。\n通常はライ麦、野菜、塩、そして少量の肉を持っている。

Line.DefaultText: He says he knows of a couple that could be interested and could tell them about you once he gets to know you better.
Line.Text: 他说他认识一对可能感兴趣的人，等他对你更了解一些后，可以向他们提起你。
Line.zh: 他说他认识一对可能感兴趣的人，等他对你更了解一些后，可以向他们提起你。
Line.en: He says he knows of a couple that could be interested and could tell them about you once he gets to know you better.
Line.ja: 興味を持ちそうな夫婦を知っており、あなたのことをもっと知れば紹介できると言った。

Line.DefaultText: He knows of two that could be interested. He says he has a couple commissions from them and they'd be happy to come provided you are able to complete them.
Line.Text: 他说有两位可能感兴趣。他手上有他们的几项委托，只要你能完成，他们会很乐意前来。
Line.zh: 他说有两位可能感兴趣。他手上有他们的几项委托，只要你能完成，他们会很乐意前来。
Line.en: He knows of two that could be interested. He says he has a couple commissions from them and they'd be happy to come provided you are able to complete them.
Line.ja: 興味を持ちそうな二人を知っていると言う。彼らからいくつか依頼を受けており、それを果たせるなら喜んで来てくれるそうだ。
